chapter_title: Concerning the Body: It was constructed after the
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of the Kephalaia Chapter on Correspondence Between the Grand Human and the Person

---

**¶2:** The whole of the spiritual world, in its celestial heights and its natural depths, is arranged according to the form of the Grand Human; and the constitution of every regenerating person accords, degree by degree, to the order of the spiritual world.

**¶3:** The inmost wisdom of the person is like the first perfections of the five external truths that clothe interior good. From the outermost boundary of that inmost degree down to the seat of the will, the person's constitution follows the pattern of the ten discrete degrees of heavenly order. The will itself accords to the living center around which the whole cycle of spiritual life revolves. From the will downward to the faculties of appropriation, the constitution is like the intermediate influx that extends from the spiritual cycle down to the natural plane. The [GAP-1: the generative natural faculty] of the person corresponds to the outermost natural plane. And from the faculties of appropriation down to the seat of generative power is like the three degrees of natural order. The sustaining structures of the lowest natural degree follow the pattern of the ground on which the foundational upholding power stands. The very base of the natural person corresponds to the outermost plane upon which that sustaining power rests, and to the four restraints upon infernal forces beneath. The organ of purification corresponds to the containing form of love's fire. The proprium — what is from self — corresponds to the containing form of falsity from evil. The vivifying spiritual life corresponds to the containing form of flowing truth.

**¶4:** Thus the individual human spirit corresponds to the whole spiritual world in its heavenly degrees, in its orderings, in its states of elevation, its boundaries of protection, and its containing forms.

**¶5:** There exist five principal provinces of spiritual governance in the great external order of the heavens, over which the five divine powers proceeding from the Lord's living operation have authority.

**¶6:** In the first and highest station of spiritual guardianship, over which the guardian of celestial wisdom presides — upon the summit of all works of divine order — is found his governance over the three inmost heavens. Then those below him [GAP-2: are under the authority of] the great governing power of spiritual honor.

**¶7:** The second station of guardianship, over which the governing power of spiritual honor presides — his own governance extends over the seven heavenly degrees of truth beneath him.

**¶8:** The third station, over which the unyielding power of divine truth [GAP-3: presides, whose governance] extends from the heavenly degree below down to the [GAP-4: natural plane]. [GAP-5: This power] quickens, according to its governance, the revolving cycle of spiritual life and the intermediate states of influx between heaven and the natural; and the other four degrees of order that are established upon the natural plane.

**¶9:** The fourth station, over which the Lord's power of glorification has dominion, consists of the three revolving cycles of purification. And its governance extends over the three natural degrees resting upon the foundation of the sustaining power.

**¶10:** The fifth station is the one over which the foundational sustaining power holds authority. It governs, according to its province, the outermost natural plane upon which it rests, and the four restraints upon infernal forces beneath.

**¶11:** Spiritual temptation and assault from evil have befallen each of these five provinces of governance in successive states.

**¶12:** In the province of the guardian of celestial wisdom, self-love from evil desired to rise up and profane the divine image presented by the Lord's representative. Yet the powers of order barred it from that height, and it fell back down into its own state of disgrace.

**¶13:** Again, a fundamental upheaval and betrayal of trust occurred in the province of the governing power of spiritual honor, in which the rebellious intelligences who had risen up at that time and had [GAP-6: transgressed the bounds of their order] — those who were cast forth descended, until they were brought into subjection.

**¶14:** Also, in the province of unyielding divine truth, premature falsities and evils descended to the natural plane and fashioned [GAP-7: the] form of the proprium — the selfhood of the external person.

**¶15:** Again, in the province of the Lord's glorifying power, a violent disturbance occurred in the three natural degrees above the sustaining foundation. The pathway was obstructed for the ascending purification of the three cycles: that of natural affection, that of truth, and that of love.

**¶16:** Also, in the province of the foundational sustaining power, the restraints upon infernal forces beneath were exposed and strained against their bonds. A great upheaval of the natural foundation took place.

**¶17:** [GAP-8: Just as] these five stations of guardianship exist in the great [GAP-9: external spiritual order as five] provinces: so it is also with the individual person. There are another five corresponding provinces within, and divine intelligence keeps watch over them, together with the new spiritual person who is being formed from within.

**¶18:** The configuration of the face, which is above the whole person: this is the spiritual reality of the guardian of celestial wisdom, who governs from the station above all external order.

**¶19:** The will, which is the inmost center: this is the sign of the governing power of spiritual honor, who brings the seven heavenly degrees of truth into subjection.

**¶20:** The generative faculty: this is the spiritual reality of the unyielding power of divine truth, which subdues the proprium and all that is merely natural.

**¶21:** The appropriating faculty and the love that burns within it: this is the likeness of the Lord's glorifying power, which turns the cycles of purification and sends the living essence upward.

**¶22:** The governing power that resides in the lowest natural degree of the person: this is the sustaining foundation, which holds in subjection beneath itself the deepest abysses of evil.

**¶23:** Also, the teaching of divine wisdom, which circulates through the whole constitution of the person: this is the likeness of the Virgin of Light — pure divine truth — which ascends and descends through all degrees of spiritual order, from the heights to the depths and back again.

**¶24:** Love and joy, faith and truth: these are the likeness of the two vessels of divine light. For through these — the vessel of celestial good and the vessel of spiritual truth — the living soul is carried upward and set free; it ascends from the deepest natural states below and arrives at the celestial heights above.

**¶25:** There exist four discrete degrees within the constitution of the person, and within these four degrees there are innumerable governing affections that rule the person's life in every particular!

**¶26:** The first degree encompasses from the outermost boundary of inmost wisdom upward — the celestial degree. The seven governing faculties within this highest degree are these: the two organs of intellectual sight, the two of obedient perception, and the two of interior discernment. The remaining one is the mouth, which is the faculty of discriminating truth from falsity.

**¶27:** The second degree extends from the boundary of inmost wisdom down through the whole region of the interior will. The seven governing faculties within this second degree are: the two active powers that correspond to the two faculties of obedient perception in the first degree above; the two faculties of interior discernment in this degree that correspond to the organs of subtle perception above; the two interior eyes of the will; and the channel of appropriation between these two, which within the interior region corresponds to the faculty of discrimination in the first degree.

**¶28:** Furthermore, there exist seven governing faculties in the third degree of the person's constitution, which are the interior organic functions: the faculty that stores abundance, the faculty that receives the breath of spiritual life, the faculty that purifies natural affections, the faculty that purifies love, the faculty that separates bitter falsity from truth, and the two faculties of interior elimination.

**¶29:** Also, in the fourth and lowest degree: there are another seven of the same kind — the two supporting foundations, the two repositories of generative potential, the two seats of procreative power; and the member through which the interior seed of truth issues forth, begetting all derivative forms of life.

**¶31:** The twelve fundamental states of spiritual progression — which in the celestial vocabulary are called Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces — these are the twelve governing principles that exist in the heavenly order above, upon the great revolving cycle. They are interlocked and bound upon this turning wheel of providence, in which they are [GAP-10: ordered], fixed, and rooted. And regarding all these twelve governing principles, this is how they were appointed and established as ruling states [GAP-11: of spiritual order] upon the revolving cycle beneath the heaven of the inmost degree. Now, they are arranged in this way so that one can trace the beginning of [GAP-12: any spiritual progression] and find also its completion [GAP-13: in its corresponding opposite state].

**¶32:** Again, these twelve states of spiritual progression, which we have set forth one after another, exist correspondingly in the person. They are counted in order and degree from the inmost to the outermost. The inmost wisdom is Aries. The capacity to receive and convey truth is Taurus. The two active powers of understanding are Gemini. The interior will that contains is Cancer. The central love that governs is Leo. The faculty of discrimination and purification is Virgo. The upright structure of moral order and the processes of interior sorting are Libra. The generative power in its hidden potency is Scorpio. The seat of procreative and propelling force is Sagittarius. The sustaining structure that bears weight is Capricorn. The supporting vessels of the lower natural degree are Aquarius. The very foundation upon which the person rests in the natural world is Pisces.

**¶33:** Behold, these twelve states are also distributed one after another. They exist within the person as if turned to one side and bent to mirror the pattern of the twelve governing principles in the heavens. They too are arranged in complementary opposition, beginning joined to end, as they occur upon the revolving wheel [GAP-14: of providence from below] upward.

**¶34:** Also, they are counted in the order and number of the whole person and all its faculties. We have declared that these states are turned to the side, bent, and spread out, because from the inmost down to the center there are six to one side, and another six to the other.

**¶35:** The six that descend along the right — the side of good — are these: the right aspect of inmost wisdom is Aries; the right capacity for receiving truth is Taurus; the right active power of understanding is Gemini; the right portion of the containing will is Cancer; the central governing love is Leo; the right aspect of the generative faculty in its purity is Virgo.

**¶36:** The other six, which are to the left — the side of truth — ascend in contrast from the center back to the inmost: the left [GAP-15: aspect of moral discernment] is Libra; the left portion of the containing will is Scorpio; the left interior faculty of warmth and purification is Sagittarius; the [GAP-16: left] active power of understanding is Capricorn; the left capacity for receiving truth is Aquarius; the left aspect of inmost wisdom is Pisces. This is how the one who forms the person's spiritual constitution has arranged them. He has [GAP-17: established] them in order and disposed them, each facing its counterpart, beginning joined to completion.

**¶38:** There exist innumerable powers within the person's constitution. These are the indwelling affections and persuasions that have been established as governing forces within. There are affections and dominant states beyond reckoning that have been made rulers within the human form! They are distributed and fixed in place, each quartered according to the faculty it inhabits. The count of their dwelling-places is vast beyond measure.

**¶39:** When all these governing affections begin to stir and move within the person, they encounter one another; and they assault and seek to destroy one another, and [GAP-18: wage conflict] among themselves within. When [GAP-19: the assault intensifies until] they erupt from the constitution of the person who [GAP-20: is undergoing] spiritual death; and they produce corrupt eruptions of evil, open wounds of falsity, and burning afflictions of self-love within the person. Either these evils make the person sick in the interior will; or else they break forth upon the external life for all to see. Those eruptions of evil must first be pressed and forced to discharge the falsity within them, and to empty out the corruption of their infection, until they are thoroughly pressed [GAP-21: clean of every impurity] and the putrefaction of falsity is driven out from the wound. Afterward, the openings in the person's spiritual fabric close over; and the person is healed and obtains relief from the states of evil that had broken forth upon them.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: This whole universe, above and below, reflects the pattern of the human body; as the formation of this body of flesh accords to the pattern of the universe.

Its head is like the first-fruits of the five garments. And, from its neck down to the site of its heart, it resembles the pattern of the ten firmaments. And again, the heart accords to the wheel of the rotating sphere. And, from its heart down to its intestines (?), is like this atmosphere that extends from the sphere down to the earth. The [male] part of the body corresponds to this great earth. And also, from its intestines (?) down to its loins is like the three earths. And also, its shinbones to the pattern of the space in which the Porter stands. Its footsoles to the great earth upon which the Porter is stood; and the four fastenings that are under his feet. Its liver to the vessel of fire. Its flesh to the vessel of darkness. Its blood to the vessel of water.
the small body corresponds to the macro-cosmos in its firmaments, in its orderings, in its mountains, its walls and its vessels
There exist five great camps in this great outer zone, of which the five sons of the Living Spirit are masters.

So, in the first watch-station above, of which the Keeper of Splendour is master, on the battlement of all the works, is found his authority over the three heavens. Then the ones below him [are under the authority of] the great King of Honour.
The second watch, of which the great King of Honour is master, his own authority (extends) over the seven firmaments beneath him.

The third watch, of which the Adamant [is master, his authority] reigns from the firmament down below to the [earth]. [And he] invigorates, according to his authority, the sphere and the worlds of the atmosphere; and the other four worlds that are appointed on this earth.
The fourth watch, over which the King of Glory has power, is the three wheels. And his authority lies over the three earths upon the head of the Porter.
The fifth watch is the watch over which the Porter is authoritative. Again, he is master, according to his authority, over this great earth he stands upon, and the four fastenings under his feet.
Affliction has come about in these five watches from time to time.
So, in the watch of the Keeper of Splendour, Sin desired to spurt up towards the image of the Ambassador. Yet, they barred it from that place, and it fell back down in shame.

Again, an earthquake and treachery occurred in the watch of the great King of Honour, which the watchers who had arisen at the time and had [sinned] they who were sent came down, until they were humbled.
Also, in the watch of the Adamant, the abortions came to the earth and fashioned [the] figure of flesh.

Again, in the watch of the King of Glory, a commotion happened in these three earths above the Porter. The pathway was obstructed for the ascent of these three wheels; that of wind, that of water, and that of fire.
Also, in the watch of the Porter, the fastenings beneath were laid bare and strained their chains. A great earthquake befell that place.

[Like] these five watch-stations, which exist in this great [outer zone as these five] camps: this is also the case with this body. There are another five camps there, and the Light Mind is watching over them, and the new man who is with him.
The configuration of his face, which is above his body: the mystery of the Keeper of Splendour, who rules over the watch above the zone.
His heart: the sign of the great King of Honour, who subdues the seven heavens.
His genitals: the mystery of the Adamant of Light, the one who subdues Matter.
The stomach and the fire that is in him: the likeness of the King of Glory, the one who turns the wheels, sending the life above.
The ruling-power that is beneath in his feet: the Porter, the one who subdues with his footsoles the abysses below.
Also, the teaching of wisdom, which circulates in that body: to the likeness of the Virgin of Light, who goes up and comes down in this zone, above and below.

love and joy, faith and truth: they are to the likeness of these two light ships. For, the living soul should go up in them and become free through them; and it ascends from the abysses below and arrives at the heights above.
There exist four worlds in this body of the flesh, and there exist countless times seven rulers in the body of the four worlds!

So, the first world is from its neck up; and also the seven rulers who are in this upper world are these: the two organs of sight, and the two of hearing, and the two of smell. The other one is the mouth, which is the organ of taste.

The second world is from its neck down to its entire upper torso. And also, the seven rulers who are in this second world are: its two arms that accord to the pattern of its two ears, which occur in its first world above; and its two breasts that are to the pattern of its organs of smell; and the two eyes of its heart; and the gullet of the stomach between the two breasts, which in the chest is the pattern of the mouth.
Once more, there exist seven rulers in the third world of the body, which are these: the fat, the lung, the spleen, the liver, the gall, and its two kidneys.

Also, the fourth world below. There are another seven there of this same kind: its two buttocks (?), and its two testicles, and its two loins; and the member out of which the seed comes, that begets all the forms.

Aries and Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius and Pisces; these are the twelve signs of the zodiac that occur in the worlds above, on the sphere. They are interlocked and bound on this turning wheel, the one in which they are [set], fixed, and planted. And, regarding all these twelve signs of the zodiac, this is how they were appointed and made leaders [in their order] on the sphere beneath the heaven that is the wheel of the stars. Now, they are appointed like this, they are thus, so that you can find the head of [each one] and you find the tail too [in the one set against it]

Again, they occur like this, these that we have recited, one after another in this body. They are counted by order and number from the head to the feet. Its head is Aries. Its neck and its shoulders are Taurus. Its two arms Gemini. Its upper torso is Cancer. Its stomach is Leo. Its belly is Virgo. The vertical spine and its intestines (?) are Libra. Its genitals Scorpio. Its loins are Sagittarius. Its knees are Capricorn. Its shinbones are Aquarius. The soles of its feet are Pisces.

Behold, these are also distributed one after another. They exist in this body, as if turned to the side and bent to the pattern of the twelve signs of the zodiac. They too are thus, arranged one against another, head to tail, as they occur on the wheel [from below] up.

Also, they are counted by order and number of the body and all its members. So, we have proclaimed that these are turned to the side, bent, and spread out; because from its head down to its hip shall count six to its left, and another six to its right.

The six that are down its right are these: the right temple is Aries; its right shoulder is Taurus; its right arm is Gemini; its right rib-cage is Cancer; its stomach is Leo; the right side of its reproductive organs are Virgo.

the other six which are to its left, in contrast they come from its hip to its head: its left [hip] is Libra; its left rib-cage is Scorpio; its left breast and left kidney is Sagittarius; its [left] elbow is Capricorn; its left shoulder is Aquarius; its left temple is Pisces. This is how the creator of the body himself has appointed them. He has [set] them in order and arranged them, one against its companion, head to tail.

There exist many powers in this body. They are the house-dwellers who are made the leaders in it. There are eight hundred and forty times ten thousand rulers made chiefs in the human body! They are distributed and set firm, quartered according to house. The count and number of their houses is two hundred and ten times ten thousand.

When all these rulers come creeping and moving within the body, they will meet one another; and they shall beset and destroy one another, and [make war] in them there. When [the affliction grows until] they shall erupt from the body of the person who [will] die; and make putrid boils and sores and burning wounds in the body. Either they might have made him sick within; or else they might come forth upon his outer side. Those wounds shall first be squeezed and discharge their liquid, and empty out their pus, until they are squeezed [clean of their impurity] and the suppuration forced out from the wound. Afterwards, their scars shall close over; and they are healed and obtain relief from the places that came out upon them.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading identifies this as "the generative natural faculty," which in the Kephalaia's anatomical register is the "male" part of the body, consistent with ¶20 and ¶29 where the genitals/generative organs correspond to the Adamant and the outermost natural plane.

The sentence transitions from the Keeper of Splendour's jurisdiction to the next watch below; "authority" is the chapter's key governance term (used in ¶7–¶10), and the spiritual reading confirms "are under the authority of."
This follows the exact formula used for each watch-station: "of which X is master, his authority (extends) over..." as seen in ¶7 (King of Honour) and ¶9 (King of Glory).
The Adamant's domain extends from the firmament down to the natural plane, which in the Kephalaia's cosmological vocabulary is "earth," consistent with the chapter's mapping of lower cosmic regions.

The subject continues as the Adamant, and "And he" follows the connective style used throughout the chapter to extend a ruler's described authority (cf. ¶10: "Again, he is master, according to his authority").

The Watchers (Egregori) who "arose" and then fell is a standard Enochic-Manichaean motif; the spiritual reading gives "transgressed the bounds of their order," which in the Kephalaia's natural register is simply "sinned."
The definite article "the" before "figure of flesh" is standard Kephalaia usage for referring to the singular bodily form fashioned by the abortions; the spiritual reading confirms "the."

The paragraph introduces an analogy from macrocosm to microcosm; "Like" opens the comparison, consistent with the chapter's repeated use of simile ("is like," "to the likeness of") and the spiritual reading's "Just as."
The phrase echoes ¶5 ("five great camps in this great outer zone") and completes the comparison: the five watch-stations in the great outer zone, as five camps, correspond to five camps in the body.

The triad "set, fixed, and planted" expresses progressive degrees of being secured in place on the zodiacal wheel, with "set" as the initial positioning before "fixed" (fastened) and "planted" (rooted).

The zodiac signs were appointed as leaders "in their order" on the sphere, reflecting the chapter's emphasis on arrangement by "order and number" (¶32, ¶34) and the spiritual reading's "of spiritual order."

The passage describes the head-to-tail arrangement of zodiac signs; "each one" generalizes the principle that any sign's beginning (head) can be found, corresponding to the spiritual reading's "any spiritual progression."

fills.fill: in the one set against it
fills.explanation: The head-to-tail opposition of zodiac signs is the chapter's central zodiacal principle; "set against" uses the chapter's own vocabulary from ¶33 ("arranged one against another") and ¶36 ("one against its companion").
The zodiac signs on the wheel proceed from below upward, matching the body's arrangement "turned to the side and bent" (¶33); the spiritual reading confirms "from below."

The left-side ascending sequence begins at the hip (the midpoint stated in ¶34: "from its head down to its hip"), and Libra corresponds to the balancing mid-body region; "hip" pairs with "right side of reproductive organs" (Virgo) on the opposite side.
The entire sequence in ¶36 describes left-side body parts ascending from hip to head; "left elbow" parallels "right arm" (Gemini) in ¶35, maintaining the bilateral symmetry.
The verb "set" in "set them in order and arranged them" follows the chapter's consistent vocabulary for cosmic and bodily arrangement (cf. GAP-10's triad and ¶31's language of ordering).

The escalating triad of hostile actions — "beset, destroy, make war" — is standard Kephalaia vocabulary for the conflict of ruling powers, and "make war" translates the spiritual reading's "wage conflict" in the text's natural register.

The visible manuscript letters "t/il" correspond to "until" spanning a line break; the clause describes the intensification of internal conflict before eruption, matching the spiritual reading's "the assault intensifies until."
The future relative "who will die" is standard Coptic construction for describing a person approaching death from the eruption of internal afflictions; the editor's choice fits the natural register.

The medical metaphor requires that wounds be squeezed until purified; "clean of their impurity" bridges the physical and spiritual sense, matching the spiritual reading's "clean of every impurity" and the passage's vocabulary of pus, suppuration, and discharge.
